subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the Home-first Wear context workflow and accept capability-gated model controls during mixed Phone/Wear version upgrades?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but deciding to remove the dedicated picker pages and establish a new paired-app protocol/UI contract is a product and upgrade-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the Home-first contract
options.body: Approve the new Home controls and capability-gated fallback, then merge once the exact head completes the required Android gates.

options.title: Keep separate picker pages
options.body: Retain the existing Wear navigation model and close or substantially narrow this feature direction.

options.title: Request an explicit migration policy
options.body: Define supported Phone/Watch version-skew expectations before deciding whether the model-control capability should ship.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first contract
recommendation.body: Approve the new Home controls and capability-gated fallback, then merge once the exact head completes the required Android gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and authored the recent compatibility and state-ordering hardening on the branch.
